parts.text:
Naji wants to fly from Abuja to Kathmandu.
He has two possible routes.
Route 1: Abuja to Cairo then Cairo to Kathmandu
Route 2: Abuja to Muscat then Muscat to Kathmandu
Use information from the table to help you complete the sentence.
You must show your working.
Route 1 is longer than Route 2 by ........................................ km [3]
